messages:
Sam (SRE): Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about the control-plane DB failover impact (INC-2026-099). RCA is live here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-099. Using this thread for short owner updates and customer comms drafts.
Lena (eng): Quick TL;DR for folks who missed it: primary control-plane DB lost connectivity during a maintenance window; failover succeeded but a backlog of metadata writes caused a long reconciliation window that sporadically returned stale routing entries for ~2.1 hours.
Ari (product): Can we get a 2-line customer-ready summary to hand to AEs? Need something non-technical.
Sam (SRE): Suggested customer line: "During scheduled maintenance, a control-plane database failover caused brief routing inconsistencies that increased latency for some customers; services returned to normal after reconciliation. We're adding safeguards to prevent a recurrence."
Jamie (CEO): Two leadership asks: 1) named owners + firm ETAs in this thread; 2) what one policy will we publish internally to reduce this class of incidents?
Sam (SRE): Owners & ETAs below. Policy one-liner suggestion: "All control-plane maintenance must include a reconciliation safety window and pre-failover metadata quiesce check."
Sam (SRE): Action 1: Add pre-failover quiesce + verification step to DB maintenance playbook  owner: Ravi (infra)  ETA: 2026-04-04.
Sam (SRE): Action 2: Implement routing reconciliation job that cross-checks registry vs router state and auto-heals drift within 5m  owner: Lena (eng)  ETA: 2026-04-07.
Sam (SRE): Action 3: Add telemetry for reconciliation latency and an alert if > 1m per-pool  owner: Sam (SRE)  ETA: 2026-03-31.
Sam (SRE): Action 4: Draft customer outreach + impacted account list  owner: Ari (product)  ETA: 2026-03-30.
Lena (eng): I'll open the reconciliation job PR today. Prototype check snippet I'm adding to CI: 
```
# reconcile-check.sh
REG_URL=$1; ROUTER_URL=$2
curl -s $REG_URL/aliases | jq -S . > /tmp/reg.json
curl -s $ROUTER_URL/mappings | jq -S . > /tmp/router.json
diff -u /tmp/reg.json /tmp/router.json || exit 1
```
Ari (product): notify-bot, please surface the impacted account list so we can prioritize outreach and notify AEs.
notify-bot: Impact summary: 6 accounts flagged. Link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-099
Ravi (infra): I'll update the maintenance playbook with the quiesce step and include a checklist. Will link PR here when ready.
Jamie (CEO): Make sure the outreach prioritizes top revenue accounts and that the AE leads are looped. Leadership wants a confirmation here once notes are sent.
Lena (eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4612  adds reconciliation worker and unit tests. Tagging @Sam @Ravi for review.
Ari (product): Draft customer message posted to #customer-comms for review (will link after approvals).
Sam (SRE): Final: marking this thread as the live all-hands follow-up for INC-2026-099. If owners change ETAs, update the all-hands tracker instead of spamming this thread. :white_check_mark:
